separation_method: content SHA-1 set intersection and repository set intersection against the training split, computed from the shipped corpus

evaluation_protocol.metric: per-token cross-entropy loss on held-out source files
evaluation_protocol.why_loss: These are real source files from unseen repositories, not executable function specifications. Loss is the only metric they support honestly.

baseline.note: A model at or above this loss has learned nothing; report it as the floor for any held-out loss figure.

limitations: Not a pass@1 code-generation benchmark; cannot report pass@1.
HumanEval (164) and MBPP (500) are not present in this repository; the 5-problem subsets in evaluation/eval_code.py exist only to prove the harness runs.
Loss on held-out files measures generalisation over unseen repositories, not task capability.
Split is grouped by repository, so the held-out set spans 2 repositories only.
